consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the standout moments of the show are the Playin' > Supplication > Playin' sequence and the Help > Slip > Drums > Slip > Franklin's Tower > Music Never Stopped segment. While some reviewers noted a few shortcomings in the overall performance, the energy and improvisational moments were highly praised.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.2 for 25 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans highlighted exceptional moments, some reviews pointed out that the overall show did not reach the heights of other performances from the same year.
